I found primary sources for the last trading day and the per-share payout of all three companies. I could not find any of the three original Standard & Poor's index-change announcements, so every S&P removal date below rests on secondary sources or company releases. The S&P-era URLs are not in the Wayback Machine, and SEC full-text search found no filing that quotes them.

---

**1. MERRILL LYNCH (MER)**

MER / LAST TRADING DAY: 2008-12-31
URL: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/65100/000095012309000005/y73627e8vk.htm
DOC: Form 8-K, Merrill Lynch & Co., filed 2009-01-02 (event date 2008-12-31)
EXCERPT: "In connection with the completion of the Merger, trading of the Common Stock on the NYSE and the CHX ceased before the opening of trading on January 2, 2009."
GRADE: PRIMARY
NOTE: 2008-12-31 is my inference. January 1 was a market holiday, so the 8-K implies Dec 31 was the last session. The NYSE Form 25-NSE for the common stock (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/65100/000087666109000017/ruleprovisionnotice.htm) agrees: the merger "became automatically effective at 12:01 a.m. on January 1, 2009"; the stock "was suspended from trading on January 2, 2009"; the NYSE planned to remove it "at the opening of business on January 15, 2009."

MER / S&P 500 REMOVAL: after the close on 2008-12-31 (replaced by SCANA, SCG)
URL: https://www.planadviser.com/financial-services-shifts-shake-up-sp-500/
DOC: "Financial Services Shifts Shake Up S&P 500", PLANADVISER, 2008-12-24
EXCERPT: "SCANA Corp. (ticker: SCG) will replace Merrill Lynch in the S&P 500 after the close of trading on Wednesday, December 31."
GRADE: SECONDARY. The S&P release itself was NOT FOUND.
NOTE: The article adds the deal was "expected to be completed on or about that date, pending final approvals." A WRDS constituent table (https://wrds-www.wharton.upenn.edu/classroom/sp500-introduction/over-time/), also SECONDARY, lists MER "1982-04-08 | 2008-12-31" and SCG starting "2009-01-02".

MER / EXIT TYPE: stock only, 0.8595 Bank of America shares per MER share
URL: same 8-K as the last trading day
EXCERPT: "each outstanding share of Common Stock ... was converted into the right to receive 0.8595 of a share of Bank of America common stock"
GRADE: PRIMARY
NOTE: No cash part. Merger effective 2009-01-01.

---

**2. SCHERING-PLOUGH (SGP)**

SGP / LAST TRADING DAY: 2009-11-03
URL: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/310158/000119312509223917/dex991.htm
DOC: Joint press release, Merck and Schering-Plough, 2009-11-03 (Exhibit 99.1 to the 8-K filed 2009-11-04)
EXCERPT: "today announced that they will complete their merger shortly after 4:00PM ET today ... Schering-Plough will change its name to Merck and its common stock will trade under the ticker symbol 'MRK' on the New York Stock Exchange."
GRADE: PRIMARY, but the date is inferred.
NOTE: No document says in so many words that "SGP ceased trading." There is no Form 25 for SGP common stock because the legal entity survived and was renamed. The Form 25-NSE filed 2009-11-04 is under old Merck's CIK 64978. For your data, the SGP CIK (310158) continues as the new MRK. You need to choose whether to treat SGP as an exit or a renamed continuation.

SGP / S&P 500 REMOVAL: 2009-11-03 by inference (replaced by Priceline.com, PCLN)
URL: https://www.rttnews.com/1112175/priceline-com-included-in-s-p-500-index-quick-facts.aspx
DOC: "Priceline.com Included In S&P 500 Index – Quick Facts", RTTNews, 2009-10-30
EXCERPT: "Standard & Poor's will add priceline.com's common stock to the S&P 500 Index ... after the close of trading on a date to be announced."
GRADE: SECONDARY. The S&P release and the follow-up giving the actual date were NOT FOUND.
NOTE: The fetched page does not name Schering-Plough. The pairing comes from an ADVFN/Dow Jones story dated 2009-10-29; its URL is in a search snippet but the page returned 403 when fetched. The search snippet said "S&P didn't disclose when the changes would occur." WRDS (SECONDARY) shows "SCHERING PLOUGH CORP | SGP, SRG | 1957-03-01 | 2009-11-03" but PCLN starting "2009-11-06". That gap is unresolved, so treat the effective date as uncertain.

SGP / EXIT TYPE: cash plus stock, $10.50 and 0.5767 new Merck shares per SGP share
URL: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/310158/000119312509223917/d8k.htm
DOC: Form 8-K, Merck & Co. (formerly Schering-Plough), filed 2009-11-04, Item 2.01
EXCERPT: "each outstanding share of common stock ... of Schering-Plough ... was converted into the right to receive $10.50 in cash and 0.5767 of a share of common stock ... of New Merck"
GRADE: PRIMARY
NOTE: Closing date given as "November 3, 2009 (the 'Closing Date')". Old Merck shares became new Merck shares one for one. SGP's 6% preferred stock stayed outstanding as "MRK PR B".

---

**3. WYETH (WYE)**

WYE / LAST TRADING DAY: 2009-10-15
URL: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0000078003/000115752309007071/a6076404ex99_1.htm
DOC: "Pfizer Completes Acquisition Of Wyeth", Pfizer press release, 2009-10-15 (Exhibit 99.1 to Pfizer's 8-K)
